source_data.desc: Just in time, you call out a fortunate warning to a creature within range. The target rolls a d4 and adds the number rolled to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw that it has just made and uses the new result for determining success or failure.
source_data.name: Auspicious Warning
source_data.reaction_condition: which you take when an ally makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw

ru.description: Как раз вовремя вы выкрикиваете благоприятное предупреждение существу в пределах дистанции.
